2608.13426.title: Reduced Matrix Multiplication: Input-Adaptive Matrix-Product Reduction for LLM Inference
2608.13426.paper_summary: Transformer-based language models achieve strong performance but incur substantial inference cost due to repeated high-dimensional matrix multiplications. We propose Reduced Matrix Multiplication (RMM), a training-free, input-adaptive inference method that reduces Transformer matrix products by selecting informative slices along their contraction dimensions, without modifying model weights. Under a simple retention-ratio control, RMM provides a smooth and predictable accuracy-efficiency trade-off. Across language models ranging from 1B to 70B parameters, we find that reduction tolerance depends on the model family, task, component, and retention ratio, although it often improves with model scale. Under moderate reduction, RMM remains robust across the evaluated discriminative, autoregressive generation, and long-context settings. We further show that the same principle extends to multimodal vision-language inference. Mechanistic ablations reveal a structural asymmetry within Transformers: attention-side computations are substantially more reducible than MLP components. Finally, wall-clock benchmarks with custom kernels on an NVIDIA A100 show that these computational savings can translate into practical runtime gains, especially at longer sequence lengths. Together, these results position RMM as a scalable direction for input-adaptive inference-time optimization.
2608.13426.paper_summary_zh: Transformer 基於的語言模型表現優異，但因為重複的高維矩陣乘法而產生相當大的推理成本。<lb/>我們提出了減少矩陣乘法（RMM），這是一種無需訓練的、輸入自適應的推理方法，通過在其收縮維度上選擇信息豐富的切片來減少 Transformer 矩陣乘積，而不修改模型權重。<lb/>在簡單的保留比率控制下，RMM 提供平滑且可預測的準確性與效率的權衡。<lb/>在從 1B 到 70B 參數的語言模型中，我們發現減少容忍度取決於模型家族、任務、組件和保留比率，儘管通常隨著模型規模的增大而改善。<lb/>在適度減少的情況下，RMM 在評估的判別性、自回歸生成和長上下文設置中保持穩健。<lb/>我們進一步顯示，這一原則擴展到多模態視覺-語言推理。<lb/>機械性消融實驗揭示了 Transformers 內部的結構不對稱性：注意力側的計算比 MLP 組件更容易減少。<lb/>最後，使用自定義內核在 NVIDIA A100 上的實時基準測試顯示，這些計算節省可以轉化為實際的運行時增益，特別是在較長的序列長度下。<lb/>綜合這些結果，使 RMM 成為一個可擴展的輸入自適應推理時間優化方向。
